full_page.content:
1932, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 62 Cont.
Aug. Mary Chenier - 56 - eyes, ears, & Spr. Bk. Mrs. Sloan - poison of face & Eyes Mrs. Kingsbury Marion -- 3 -- paralysis Page 63 Blank Page
Page 64
Aug. Fr. Herman ..... Contest
Mrs. M. Smith -25 - Husband convert - n.g. away - 2 little babies $5 per week - now laid off
Rose Cowan - 40 - nervous & mentally weak ... Mother hopes someone may be interested and help
Mich. Tagnrel - 40 - Heart - liver - kidney trouble Theresa Pajot - 63 - threatened cancer oper'n Mr. & Mrs. McDermott ... to sell property & move Mrs. Coveny - 48 - business lady from N.Y. trying to make honest living ....
Joanna O'Meara .... very nervous
Norbert Nowak - 21 - went away at 16-after some months returns - night before father's funeral .... Pray he make Emer. Welfare Dept. Cletus Hartman S. J. - fits. Miss Rainey - sprained ankle
Gladys McDonald & 3 other swimmers
Mrs. Marth. Burns - 47 - can not swallow - very nervous .... Mrs. Mary Basher 25 - one little girl, seems to be losing mind ... Mrs. May Carrier - 53 - mother of 12 & Grandmother - Arthritis. ... Knee-cap gone. ..
